query:
SELECT
            COALESCE(model, 'unrouted') AS "model!",
            COUNT(DISTINCT context_id)::bigint AS "conversations!",
            COUNT(*)::bigint AS "ai_requests!"
          FROM ai_requests
          WHERE user_id = $1
            AND context_id <> $2
            AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
          GROUP BY COALESCE(model, 'unrouted')
          ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
          LIMIT 5
